newsitem.title: USA: Cylink sees revs growth out-pacing market.
newsitem.headline: Cylink sees revs growth out-pacing market.

text.p: Cylink Corp expects its revenue growth to exceed that of the rapidly growing key encryption and network security market, President and Chief Executive Officer Fernand Sarrat said Friday.

Sarrat said in a presentation to investors at a Hambrecht and Quist Internet technology conference here that the company expects to outpace industry growth, projected independently at around 50 percent annually.
Sarrat said the company's experience in developing security applications over many years provided it with a competitive advantage over newcomers to the market.
"We believe that we have a real leg up," he told investors at the conference.
He said of developing security systems, "It takes so long to develop them (that) they become a barrier to entry."
